title: The Mereon circuit is a topological eigenform

statements.text: An eigenform is a fixed point of a recursive process, and the closed circuit from the Mereon System to the trefoil, the Poincaré homology sphere, the binary icosahedral group and the 600-cell back to the Mereon System is a topological eigenform: the system generates the structure whose properties regenerate the system.

sources.quote: An eigenform [20] is a fixed point of a recursive process: the system generates the structure whose properties regenerate the system
